title: Drop gate on the champion's lethal release: no early laser release while a supply drop is near and reachable within DROP_RUN_M, or while on a drop run / ring hold / capture (LETHAL_DROP_GATE_ON)
behaviors: inside the champion's LETHAL_RELEASE logic only: do not take the early (partial-charge) release while a called drop not held by another mech is within DROP_RUN_M and reachable by the drop run's own zone-safe ETA test, or while dropRun / ring hold (dropHold) / drop capture (farmHold) is active; everything else is the champion
renumber_note: P34b now = one drop gate on top of champion P34 (0e6fadd, merged 8c130ad, LETHAL_RELEASE_ON already true). The earlier GUN_NEAR_M distance variant (/workspace/patches/p34b-old-bot.diff, built on the old base) is NOT this build.

screens.verdict: BARELY FIRES: 0/192 games where the gate blocks a release the champion took. Gate on while a lethal release was otherwise due: 15 ticks (base 0), every one also inside the champion's own dropOpen() gate. All 192 games equal to the champion in every CSV column except bot timing (bot_ms_mean, late_over_50ms). Paired +0.000 +/- 0.000, 0/96/0 on each base. t<10 s activations 0

decision: BARELY FIRES (0/192); stopped before the 4-base hazard run per brief
blocker: By construction the gate is a subset of the champion's existing P34 drop test (brain.ts dropOpen(): dropRun set, or any called drop not held by another mech within DROP_RUN_M flat). dropHold only happens with dropRun set; farmHold needs a drop within FARM_PICKUP_M 80 m < 200 m; a reachable drop within DROP_RUN_M is a drop within DROP_RUN_M. So the champion never early-releases while a drop is near/reachable or during a run/hold/capture. The lost arrivals (2078, 2089 on the old base) come from divergence after releases made before any drop was called (P34 record: 46-47 s kills, drops lost 150-235 s later), which no drop-time gate can touch.
next_action: Grok: decide retire or re-scope (stage left at hold for Grok). Any real change would have to gate releases with no drop near, which is a different idea, and the drop rule forbids gating on 'any drop exists'
